summary: Vice President Investment Research & Portfolio Management candidate with ~7 years across institutional investment research, multi-asset portfolio analytics, and investment governance. Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5-25bn per engagement) at Moody's Analytics, with earlier VaR/CVaR portfolio optimization, LDI, and strategic asset allocation advisory at Ortec Finance. CFA charterholder; dual MSc (Financial Modelling, Engineering). Strong in translating research into investment-committee-ready decisions.

experience.employer: Moody's Analytics — Asset Management & Buy-Side Solutions

sections.heading: Investment Research & Portfolio Analytics
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional portfolios ranging $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to release.
Reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level analytics and performance metrics feeding downstream investment and capital processes.
Validated derivatives outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, ensuring consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at multi-asset portfolio aggregates.

sections.heading: Governance, Oversight & Compliance
bullets: Operate within a formal model-governance framework as a member of the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.
Escalated outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility, serving as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues and holding releases pending remediation.

sections.heading: Client & Investment-Committee Engagement
bullets: Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders and clients' Heads of Risk, translating quantitative outputs into investment-committee-ready narratives on exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities.

Led design of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, delivering forward-looking portfolio and liquidity visibility across investment horizons.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform, advising on asset, liability, and portfolio configurations.
Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners; validated model outputs post-deployment and migrated all assigned accounts from the legacy Calypso platform.

roles.title: Senior Consultant — IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with financial-reporting and governance frameworks.
Advised actuarial, finance, IT, and program-management functions on adoption, contributing to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.

Advised institutional clients on Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) and Tactical Asset Allocation (TAA) trade-offs via stress testing and sensitivity analysis, presenting findings and recommendations to pension-fund investment committees on-site.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, risk budgeting, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test allocation robustness.

Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis across return objectives, duration alignment, and liquidity, and built stochastic economic scenario generators to assess funding volatility under base and stressed environments.

Led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger, developing and validating the model capturing all funding-policy dynamics across duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
